# Jankx WooCommerce Layout System

Hệ thống quản lý layouts cho WooCommerce với kiến trúc mở rộng và hiệu năng cao.

## Kiến trúc tổng quan

Hệ thống sử dụng các Design Patterns chính:
- Registry Pattern: LayoutManager quản lý tất cả layouts
- Singleton Pattern: Managers (Layout, CSS, Settings) đều là singleton
- Template Method Pattern: Abstract classes định nghĩa skeleton, child override chi tiết
- Strategy Pattern: Layouts có thể swap dynamically

## Cấu trúc core

### Interfaces (Contracts/)
- LayoutInterface: Base interface cho tất cả layouts
- CssManagerInterface: Quản lý CSS compilation và injection
- LayoutManagerInterface: Registry cho layouts
- SettingsInterface: Quản lý settings cho layouts

### Layout-specific Interfaces (Contracts/Layouts/)
- ProductDetailLayoutInterface: Product detail pages
- ProductLoopLayoutInterface: Product listing/grid
- ProductCategoryBlockLayoutInterface: Category blocks
- ProductGalleryLayoutInterface: Product galleries
- CartFormLayoutInterface: Cart forms (mini cart, widget)
- CartPageLayoutInterface: Cart page
- CheckoutPageLayoutInterface: Checkout page
- QuickCheckoutLayoutInterface: Quick checkout (custom feature)

### Abstract Classes (Abstracts/)
- AbstractLayout: Base cho tất cả layouts, implement common logic
- AbstractCssManager: Base cho CSS managers
- Abstract layout classes (Abstracts/Layouts/): Một abstract cho mỗi layout type

### Core System (LayoutSystem/)
- LayoutManager: Registry quản lý layouts (Singleton)
- CssManager: Compile SCSS và inject inline CSS (Singleton)
- SettingsManager: Quản lý settings và generate dynamic CSS (Singleton)
- LayoutBootstrap: Bootstrap và khởi tạo hệ thống

### Concrete Layouts (Layouts/)
Mỗi loại có default layouts:
- ProductDetail/: DefaultProductDetailLayout
- ProductLoop/: GridProductLoopLayout, ListProductLoopLayout
- CategoryBlock/: GridCategoryBlockLayout
- Gallery/: SliderGalleryLayout
- Cart/: DefaultCartPageLayout
- Checkout/: DefaultCheckoutLayout, MultiStepCheckoutLayout
- QuickCheckout/: ModalQuickCheckoutLayout

## CSS Management Strategy

### Inline CSS Only (Core Web Vitals Optimization)
- Không dùng external CSS files
- CSS được inject trực tiếp vào HTML via <style> tag
- Mỗi layout có common CSS (compiled từ SCSS) và dynamic CSS (generated từ settings)

### SCSS Compilation
```php
// SCSS files tại: assets/scss/layouts/{type}/{layout-id}.scss
$cssManager = CssManager::getInstance();
$css = $cssManager->compile('/path/to/layout.scss');
```

### Dynamic CSS Generation
```php
// Child layouts override generateDynamicCss()
protected function generateDynamicCss(array $settings): string {
    $css = '';
    if (isset($settings['primary_color'])) {
        $css .= ".layout-{$this->id} .button { background: {$settings['primary_color']}; }";
    }
    return $css;
}
```

### CSS Injection Flow
1. Determine current layout based on page context
2. Get settings for layout
3. Compile common CSS (cached)
4. Generate dynamic CSS from settings
5. Combine và inject vào wp_head
6. Track injected CSS để avoid duplicates

### Caching Strategy
- Compiled SCSS cached in transients
- Cache key includes file modification time
- Development mode (WP_DEBUG) bypasses cache
- Cache cleared khi settings thay đổi

## Tạo Layout mới

### Từ Theme
```php
// Extend abstract class phù hợp
class MyCustomLayout extends AbstractProductDetailLayout {
    public function __construct() {
        parent::__construct(
            'my-custom-layout',
            __('My Custom Layout'),
            'product-detail'
        );
        $this->supportedSettings = ['option1', 'option2'];
    }
    
    // Override methods nếu cần
    public function renderGallery(WC_Product $product): string {
        return '<div>Custom gallery</div>';
    }
}

// Đăng ký
add_action('jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts', function($manager) {
    $manager->register(new MyCustomLayout());
});
```

### SCSS File Structure
```scss
// assets/scss/layouts/{type}/{layout-id}.scss
.product-detail-my-custom-layout {
    .gallery { /* styles */ }
    .summary { /* styles */ }
    
    @media (max-width: 768px) { /* responsive */ }
}
```

## Settings Management

### Lưu và đọc settings
```php
$settings = SettingsManager::getInstance();

// Set single setting
$settings->set('layout-id.color', '#ff0000');

// Set multiple
$settings->setLayoutSettings('layout-id', [
    'color' => '#ff0000',
    'spacing' => 20
]);

// Get settings
$color = $settings->get('layout-id.color');
$all = $settings->getLayoutSettings('layout-id');
```

### Generate CSS from Settings
```php
// Tự động generate CSS từ settings
$css = $settings->generateCss('layout-id');

// Custom CSS generator
$settings->registerCssGenerator('product-detail', function($layoutId, $settings) {
    return ".layout { color: {$settings['color']}; }";
});
```

## Hooks và Filters

### Actions
- `jankx_woocommerce_register_default_layouts`: Đăng ký default layouts
- `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts`: External registration từ themes/plugins
- `jankx_woocommerce_layout_registered`: After layout registered
- `jankx_woocommerce_default_layout_changed`: Default layout changed

### Filters
- `jankx_woocommerce_allow_layout_override`: Allow duplicate layout IDs
- `jankx_woocommerce_current_layout`: Override current layout
- `jankx_woocommerce_default_layout_id`: Override default layout ID
- `jankx_woocommerce_compiled_css`: Modify compiled CSS
- `jankx_woocommerce_scss_import_paths`: Add SCSS import paths
- `jankx_woocommerce_validate_layout_settings`: Custom validation

## API Usage Examples

### Get Layout Manager
```php
$manager = \Jankx\WooCommerce\LayoutSystem\LayoutManager::getInstance();

// Get layout
$layout = $manager->get('layout-id');

// Get by type
$detailLayouts = $manager->getByType('product-detail');

// Get default
$defaultLayout = $manager->getDefault('product-detail');

// Set default
$manager->setDefault('product-detail', 'my-layout-id');
```

### Inject Layout CSS
```php
$cssManager = \Jankx\WooCommerce\LayoutSystem\CssManager::getInstance();
$settings = ['color' => '#ff0000'];

// Inject layout CSS
$cssManager->injectLayoutCss($layout, $settings);

// Or manual
$css = $layout->getCommonCss() . $layout->getDynamicCss($settings);
$cssManager->inject($css, $layout->getId());
```

### Override Current Layout
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    if ($type === 'product-detail' && is_product(123)) {
        $manager = LayoutManager::getInstance();
        return $manager->get('special-layout');
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

## Layout Types và Methods

### Product Detail Layout
Methods: renderGallery(), renderSummary(), renderMeta(), renderTabs(), renderRelatedProducts()
Settings: gallery_width, primary_color, show_related_products, sticky_add_to_cart

### Product Loop Layout
Methods: renderProduct(), renderThumbnail(), renderTitle(), renderPrice(), renderBadges(), renderQuickView()
Settings: columns, item_spacing, border_radius, show_quick_view, hover_effect

### Cart Page Layout
Methods: renderCartTable(), renderCartActions(), renderCrossSells(), renderCartCollaterals()
Settings: show_cross_sells, show_shipping_calculator, table_style

### Checkout Page Layout
Methods: renderBillingFields(), renderShippingFields(), renderOrderReview(), renderPaymentMethods()
Settings: layout_style (single/two-column/multi-step), field_spacing, button_color

## Performance Optimization

### CSS Strategy
- Inline CSS only (no external requests)
- SCSS compiled và cached
- Minified in production
- Only inject CSS for current page layout
- Avoid duplicate injections

### Caching
- Compiled CSS cached in transients
- Cache invalidation on settings change
- Development mode bypasses cache
- Cache keys include file modification time

### Best Practices
- Use SCSS variables và mixins
- Keep layouts focused (Single Responsibility)
- Validate settings before generating CSS
- Use lazy loading for heavy computations
- Minimize CSS output (only essential styles)

## Extension Points

Themes và plugins có thể:
1. Register custom layouts via `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts`
2. Override default layouts via filters
3. Add custom settings cho layouts
4. Register custom CSS generators
5. Override templates trong theme directory
6. Add SCSS import paths
7. Hook vào lifecycle events

## Common Patterns

### Conditional Layout Loading
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    // Load different layout based on conditions
    if (user_is_premium()) {
        return $manager->get('premium-layout');
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

### Custom Settings UI
```php
// Add settings fields trong theme customizer/options page
// Save to SettingsManager
$settings->setLayoutSettings($layoutId, $_POST['layout_settings']);
```

### A/B Testing Layouts
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_current_layout', function($layout, $type) {
    if ($type === 'product-detail') {
        $variant = get_ab_test_variant();
        return $manager->get("product-detail-variant-{$variant}");
    }
    return $layout;
}, 10, 2);
```

## Technical Details

### Dependencies
- WordPress 5.0+
- WooCommerce 4.0+
- PHP 7.4+
- scssphp/scssphp (SCSS compiler)

### File Locations
- Interfaces: includes/Contracts/
- Abstracts: includes/Abstracts/
- Managers: includes/LayoutSystem/
- Concrete layouts: includes/Layouts/
- SCSS: assets/scss/layouts/
- Templates: templates/layouts/

### Naming Conventions
- Layout IDs: kebab-case (e.g., 'grid-product-loop')
- Class names: PascalCase (e.g., GridProductLoopLayout)
- Methods: camelCase (e.g., renderProduct())
- Settings keys: snake_case (e.g., 'primary_color')

Đây là hệ thống layout hoàn chỉnh và production-ready cho WooCommerce với focus vào performance, extensibility và maintainability.

## Service Provider System

### WooCommerceLayoutServiceProvider
Quản lý configuration từ file và theme options với priority:
1. Theme Options (highest)
2. Config File
3. Defaults (lowest)

### Config File
Location: `themes/cheephub/config/woocomerce.php`

Structure:
```php
return [
    'product_detail' => [
        'default_layout' => 'layout-id',
        'enabled' => true,
        'settings' => [...],
    ],
    // ... 8 layout types total
    'global' => [...],
];
```

### Theme Options Integration
Auto-integration với:
- Redux Framework
- Titan Framework
- Kirki
- WordPress Theme Mods

Mapping example:
- Theme mod `woo_loop_columns` → `product_loop.settings.columns`
- Redux option `product_detail_gallery_width` → `product_detail.settings.gallery_width`

### API Usage
```php
$provider = \Jankx\WooCommerce\Providers\WooCommerceLayoutServiceProvider::getInstance();

// Get config
$value = $provider->get('product_detail.settings.gallery_width');
$config = $provider->getConfig();

// Update theme option
$provider->updateThemeOption('product_loop.settings.columns', 3);

// Reload
$provider->reload();
```

### Configuration Priority Flow
```
Load config file
    ↓
Load theme options (Redux/Titan/Kirki/Theme Mods)
    ↓
Deep merge (theme options override config)
    ↓
Apply to layouts via SettingsManager
    ↓
Generate dynamic CSS
```

### Auto-loading
Service Provider tự động khởi tạo qua LayoutBootstrap.
Config được load trong hook `after_setup_theme` (priority 15).
Settings được apply trong hook `jankx_woocommerce_register_layouts` (priority 100).

Xem SERVICE_PROVIDER.md để biết chi tiết về configuration system.

## Expand/Collapse Category Layout (NEW!)

### Flatsome-Inspired Accordion Layout
Layout mới theo style Flatsome theme với expand/collapse functionality.

**Class**: `ExpandCollapseCategoryLayout`
**ID**: `expand-collapse-category`
**Type**: `product-category-block`

### Features
- Accordion với smooth slide animation
- Show subcategories khi expand
- Show 4 featured products preview
- Support nested categories (unlimited depth)
- Current category auto-expand
- 3 accordion styles: default, minimal, card
- 3 icon styles: plus-minus, arrow, chevron
- Configurable animation speed (default 300ms)
- Responsive design (4 cols → 2 cols → mobile)
- Pure vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery)
- Keyboard accessible

### WooCommerce Block Integration
Hook `CategoryBlockFilterHook` transform WooCommerce Product Categories block HTML:

**Flow**:
```
WooCommerce Block → Generates nested <ul>
    ↓
CategoryBlockFilterHook (filter: render_block)
    ↓
Parse HTML → Extract categories → Maintain hierarchy
    ↓
Render with ExpandCollapseCategoryLayout
    ↓
Beautiful accordion với expand/collapse
```

**Enable**:
```php
add_filter('jankx_woocommerce_category_block_use_accordion', '__return_true');
```

**Config**:
```php
'product_category_block' => [
    'use_accordion' => true,
    'default_layout' => 'expand-collapse-category',
    'settings' => [
        'accordion_style' => 'card', // default, minimal, card
        'icon_style' => 'chevron', // plus-minus, arrow, chevron
        'animation_speed' => 300,
        'show_subcategories' => true,
        'show_product_preview' => true,
        'default_expanded' => false,
    ],
],
```

**Methods**:
- `renderNestedCategory()` - Render single category với children
- `renderNestedCategories()` - Render từ parsed data structure
- `hasSubcategories()` - Check có children không
- `renderSubcategories()` - Render child categories list
- `renderProductPreview()` - Render 4 featured products
- `renderScript()` - Inline JavaScript cho expand/collapse

### Parsed Category Data Structure
```php
[
    'id' => 439,
    'name' => 'SÁCH CŨ & MỚI',
    'url' => '/category/sach-cu-moi/',
    'is_current' => false,
    'is_current_ancestor' => true,
    'children' => [
        [
            'id' => 440,
            'name' => 'SÁCH CŨ',
            'children' => [...],
        ],
    ],
]
```

## Logging System (NEW!)

### Debug Tracking
Complete logging system để track package loading và debug issues.

**Logger Class**: `Jankx\WooCommerce\Helpers\Logger`

**Enable**:
```php
// wp-config.php
define('JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT_DEBUG', true);

// Optional: Custom log file
define('JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT_LOG_FILE', WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/jankx-woo-debug.log');

// Or via URL (when WP_DEBUG = true)
?jankx_woo_debug=1
```

**Log Levels**:
- INFO - Major events (bootstrap, registration, compilation)
- DEBUG - Detailed step-by-step execution
- WARNING - Non-critical issues (duplicates, fallbacks)
- ERROR - Critical failures

**View Logs**:
1. WordPress debug.log: `tail -f wp-content/debug.log | grep "JANKX_WOO"`
2. Custom file: `tail -f wp-content/jankx-woo-debug.log`
3. Admin Bar: "Jankx WooCommerce Logs (X)"
4. Screen dump: `?jankx_woo_dump_logs=1`

**Logged Events**:
- Package bootstrap (start, load files, initialize, complete)
- Service provider registration và boot
- Layout registration (ID, type, name, count)
- CSS compilation (file, size, cache status, duration)
- Configuration loading (source, size, layout types)
- Performance metrics (duration_ms, memory_mb, size_bytes)

**Log Format**:
```
[Timestamp] [Level] [JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT] Message | Context: {JSON}
```

**Example**:
```
2025-12-05 10:30:45 [INFO] [JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT] LayoutManager: Layout registered successfully | Context: {"layout_id":"grid-product-loop","total_layouts":3,"type_layouts":1}
```

**API**:
```php
use Jankx\WooCommerce\Helpers\Logger;

Logger::info('Message', ['context' => 'data']);
Logger::debug('Detailed info');
Logger::warning('Something suspicious');
Logger::error('Critical error');

// Get logs
$logs = Logger::getLogs();
$errors = Logger::getLogsByLevel('ERROR');

// Dump to screen
Logger::dump();

// Admin bar display
Logger::addToAdminBar();
```

**Performance**:
- Enabled: < 1ms overhead per log
- Disabled: Zero overhead (early return on isDebugEnabled check)
- No database queries
- Memory efficient (~100 bytes per entry)

**Production**:
Set `JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT_DEBUG = false` to disable completely.
Logs có prefix `[JANKX_WOO_LAYOUT]` để dễ filter và remove.

See LOGGING.md và DEBUG.md để biết chi tiết.

## CSS & JavaScript Inline Strategy

### Critical Rule: NO External CSS/JS Files
Để đạt Core Web Vitals cao, hệ thống KHÔNG BAO GIỜ load external CSS hoặc JS files.

### CSS Inline Injection Strategy

**Implementation**:
1. SCSS files compiled to CSS (cached in transients)
2. Common CSS + Dynamic CSS combined
3. Injected INLINE vào `<style>` tag trong `wp_head`
4. Track injected layouts để avoid duplicates
5. Only inject CSS for current page layout

**Flow**:
```
Page Load
    ↓
Determine current layout (is_product, is_shop, etc.)
    ↓
Get layout settings
    ↓
Compile common CSS (SCSS → CSS, cached)
    ↓
Generate dynamic CSS (from settings)
    ↓
Combine: $commonCss + $dynamicCss
    ↓
CssManager::inject($css, $layoutId)
    ↓
wp_head hook (priority 999)
    ↓
Output: <style id="jankx-woo-inline-css">{minified CSS}</style>
```

**Verification**:
HTML source sẽ có:
```html
<!-- Jankx WooCommerce Inline CSS -->
<style id="jankx-woo-inline-css" type="text/css">
.product-loop-grid-product-loop{display:grid;gap:20px}...
</style>
```

KHÔNG có:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="...jankx-woo.css">
```

**Benefits**:
- Zero external CSS requests
- No render blocking
- Better LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)
- Improved Core Web Vitals scores
- Only needed CSS loaded

**Classes**:
- `AbstractCssManager::outputInjectedCss()` - Output inline CSS
- `CssManager::inject()` - Track và store CSS
- `CssManager::injectLayoutCss()` - Inject layout CSS
- `CssManager::isInjected()` - Check duplicate

### JavaScript Inline Strategy

**Critical Rule**: KHÔNG BAO GIỜ load external JavaScript files. Tất cả JS phải inline hoặc internal.

**Requirements**:
1. NO external JS files (<script src="...">)
2. Only inline/internal JavaScript (<script>...</script>)
3. Pure vanilla JavaScript (NO jQuery, NO libraries)
4. Generate qua PHP theo layout
5. Common JS cho shared functionality
6. Layout-specific JS cho specific features

**Implementation Strategy**:

1. **Common JavaScript** (Shared functionality):
   - Định nghĩa trong layout's renderScript() method
   - Inject inline vào HTML
   - Reusable utilities (slideUp, slideDown, toggle, etc.)
   - Event delegation for performance

2. **Layout-Specific JavaScript**:
   - Generated qua PHP trong layout class
   - Injected inline trong layout render
   - Self-contained, no dependencies
   - Feature-specific (accordion, slider, modal, etc.)

3. **JavaScript từ Settings**:
   - Generate JS dựa trên user settings
   - Dynamic configuration (speed, behavior, options)
   - Injected inline with layout
   - Type-safe values

**Flow**:
```
Layout Render
    ↓
Generate common JS (reusable functions)
    ↓
Generate layout-specific JS (features)
    ↓
Generate dynamic JS (from settings)
    ↓
Combine: commonJS + layoutJS + dynamicJS
    ↓
Inject inline: <script>combined JS</script>
    ↓
Output trong wp_footer (priority 999)
```

**Example - Expand/Collapse Layout**:
```php
protected function renderScript(): string {
    ob_start();
    ?>
    <script>
    (function() {
        'use strict'; // Pure vanilla JS
        
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            const container = document.querySelector('.jankx-categories-expand-collapse');
            if (!container) return;
            
            // Get settings from data attributes
            const animationSpeed = parseInt(container.dataset.animationSpeed) || 300;
            
            // Event delegation
            container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                const toggleBtn = e.target.closest('.category-toggle');
                if (!toggleBtn) return;
                
                // Toggle logic
                // ... pure vanilla JavaScript
            });
        });
    })();
    </script>
    <?php
    return ob_get_clean();
}
```

**Verification**:
HTML source sẽ có:
```html
<!-- Inline JavaScript trong layout -->
<div class="jankx-categories-expand-collapse">
    <!-- HTML content -->
</div>
<script>
(function() {
    'use strict';
    // Pure vanilla JavaScript code here
    // NO jQuery: $()
    // NO libraries: library.method()
    // YES vanilla: document.querySelector()
})();
</script>
```

KHÔNG có:
```html
<script src="/path/to/external.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.com/library.js"></script>
```

**Benefits**:
- Zero external JS requests
- No render blocking scripts
- Better FID (First Input Delay)
- Improved Core Web Vitals
- Faster page load
- Only needed JS loaded

**JavaScript Methods in Layouts**:
- `renderScript()` - Generate inline JavaScript
- `getJavaScriptConfig()` - Get JS configuration từ settings
- `renderCommonJs()` - Common utilities
- `renderFeatureJs()` - Feature-specific code

**Common JS Utilities** (inline trong layouts):
```javascript
// Slide animations
function slideDown(element, duration) { }
function slideUp(element, duration) { }

// DOM utilities
function addClass(element, className) { }
function removeClass(element, className) { }
function toggleClass(element, className) { }

// Event utilities
function on(selector, event, handler) { } // Event delegation

// Ajax utilities (vanilla)
function ajax(url, data, callback) {
    fetch(url, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify(data)
    }).then(r => r.json()).then(callback);
}
```

**NO Dependencies**:
- ❌ jQuery
- ❌ Lodash
- ❌ Moment.js
- ❌ Any external library
- ✅ Pure vanilla JavaScript only

**Modern JavaScript Features** (OK to use):
- ✅ ES6+ syntax (const, let, arrow functions)
- ✅ Template literals
- ✅ Fetch API
- ✅ Promise
- ✅ Async/await
- ✅ Array methods (map, filter, reduce)
- ✅ DOM API (querySelector, addEventListener)

**Code Organization**:
```
Layout Class
    ↓
renderScript() method
    ↓
Generate inline <script>
    ↓
Pure vanilla JavaScript
    ↓
Self-contained, no external deps
```

**Testing JavaScript**:
Tests verify JS được generate correctly:
- Content type check
- No external src
- Pure vanilla syntax
- Self-contained code
- Proper escaping

**Performance**:
- Inline JS = no additional HTTP requests
- Minimal code (only what's needed)
- Event delegation (efficient)
- No library overhead
- Fast execution
